notes: Fixes the blank Sites/Admin section and missing shared users. Sites is now a standalone stable view rather than a legacy Admin grouping, with Main Hotel/site status, Create site and clean-start information. Safety People now shows All app users at the top from the shared Inventory/Energy directory, followed separately by Safety accounts. The shared mirror is already populated with the 5 current shared users. Also blocks known legacy Admin whole-subtree observer feedback loops before those modules initialise. No new SQL required for this frontend patch.
